name: Blogger

sources.title: Blogger start page — create a blog, free blogspot.com domain, AdSense monetization

requirements: A Google account — Blogger is Google's free blogging platform
Content must comply with Blogger's Content Policy
preparation: Blog title and desired blogspot.com subdomain
Launch-content plan — a post announcing the product with links back to your site
workflow: Go to blogger.com/start or blogger.com/go/createyourblog and sign in with a Google account
Create the blog: pick a title and a free blogspot.com address (or buy a custom domain through Google)
Publish a post about the product (e.g., launch announcement) containing the product URL
Confirm the blog is publicly reachable at <name>.blogspot.com
watchFor: This is a content platform, not a directory — value comes from a live public blog, not a profile listing
Inactive/spammy blogs risk removal under the Content Policy
AdSense monetization prompts are built into the funnel — optional, ignore for listing purposes
countsAsLive: The blog is publicly accessible at <name>.blogspot.com and the launch post with your product link renders to anonymous visitors
unknowns: Whether outbound links in Blogger posts are dofollow (not stated on the start page)
